summary: The interactive FastAPI assistant has no OpenTelemetry GenAI spans or bounded token, tool, retrieval, and stream telemetry. The optional offline eval_runner.py has its own Splunk AO SDK project, stream, trace, and teardown path; that path is not imported or invoked by app.py and does not cover live chat.

evidence.finding: The base FastAPI service has no OpenTelemetry dependency; the optional evaluation extra installs splunk-ao for an offline runner
App-owned assistant, provider, tool, and streaming lifecycle
Chat, stream, feedback, and health routes

eval_runner.py resolves an existing evaluation project, resolves or creates an offline Agent Stream, emits a synthetic trace, then concludes, flushes, and terminates its own logger; app.py does not import or call this runner

signal_flow.component_flow_map:
Interactive assistant lifecycle
FastAPI routes [SOURCE-COVERED] -> build_turn [GAP: Assistant GenAI lifecycle] -> run_tool search_docs [GAP: Document retrieval inside search_docs] -> call_provider [SOURCE-COVERED]

Offline evaluation (separate process)
eval_runner.py [SOURCE-COVERED] -> synthetic Splunk AO project, stream, trace, and logger teardown [SOURCE-COVERED]; not reachable from app.py

Interactive Agent Observability deployment
project binding [GAP: Agent Observability project resource] -> dedicated Agent Stream binding [GAP: Dedicated Agent Stream resource] -> configured API/ingest endpoint [GAP: Agent Observability runtime routing]

genai_readiness.required_signals: chat demo-gpt-4o-mini span with gen_ai.operation.name=chat, gen_ai.provider.name=demo-provider, and gen_ai.request.model=demo-gpt-4o-mini; execute_tool {tool} spans bounded to execute_tool search_docs and execute_tool lookup_customer, each with gen_ai.operation.name=execute_tool and its matching gen_ai.tool.name; gen_ai.client.token.usage metric with gen_ai.token.type; assistant.stream.active metric
genai_readiness.acceptance_criteria: A bounded chat run emits the chat demo-gpt-4o-mini, execute_tool search_docs, and execute_tool lookup_customer spans plus gen_ai.client.token.usage and assistant.stream.active metrics without prompt, completion, session, or tool-argument dimensions.
genai_readiness.impact: Operators cannot localize model, tool, token-pressure, or streaming failures in the assistant lifecycle.

genai_readiness.required_signals: Preserve execute_tool search_docs and add exactly one child retrieval demo-knowledge-base span with gen_ai.operation.name=retrieval and gen_ai.data_source.id=demo-knowledge-base.
genai_readiness.acceptance_criteria: A search_docs call emits exactly one tool span and one nested retrieval span with direct parentage and no gen_ai.retrieval.query.text or gen_ai.retrieval.documents content attributes.
genai_readiness.impact: The trace cannot distinguish tool dispatch from the code-owned knowledge-base retrieval performed inside search_docs.

findings.title: Emit the app-owned GenAI lifecycle
findings.gap: The app-owned assistant, provider, tool, token, and streaming lifecycle emits no OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry.
findings.impact: Model and tool failures, token pressure, and stream concurrency cannot be localized from telemetry.
findings.product_outcome: The trace waterfall and metric explorer show one bounded app-owned assistant lifecycle.
findings.required_fix: Add one reusable OpenTelemetry setup path and emit bounded app-owned GenAI spans and metrics for the assistant lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded chat run emits the chat demo-gpt-4o-mini, execute_tool search_docs, and execute_tool lookup_customer spans plus gen_ai.client.token.usage and assistant.stream.active metrics.
constraints: Do not record raw prompts, completions, session IDs, user values, request IDs, or tool arguments as metric dimensions.
follow_up_actions: Inspect the app-owned GenAI trace waterfall and chart the bounded token and active-stream metrics.

findings.title: Emit the nested search_docs retrieval operation
findings.gap: search_docs returns document matches and scores for model context, but the retrieval operation has no distinct OpenTelemetry span.
findings.impact: Operators cannot isolate retrieval latency or failure from the outer tool dispatch.
findings.product_outcome: The trace waterfall preserves the search_docs tool and shows one nested demo knowledge-base retrieval operation.
findings.required_fix: Preserve exactly one execute_tool search_docs span and add exactly one direct child retrieval demo-knowledge-base span with stable retrieval semantic attributes.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded search_docs call emits exactly one execute_tool search_docs parent and exactly one nested retrieval demo-knowledge-base child with gen_ai.operation.name=retrieval and gen_ai.data_source.id=demo-knowledge-base.
Neither span records gen_ai.retrieval.query.text, gen_ai.retrieval.documents, raw prompts, nor retrieved document content.
constraints: Keep the data-source identifier stable and low-cardinality; do not capture query text, document bodies, embeddings, or result payloads.
follow_up_actions: Inspect the nested search_docs retrieval span and confirm its direct parent and content-privacy boundary.

findings.title: Resolve the Agent Observability project
findings.gap: The interactive FastAPI deployment has no resolved Agent Observability project binding or project identifier; eval_runner.py resolves a separate optional evaluation project only.
findings.impact: Agent traces have no verified project destination.
findings.product_outcome: An existing or authorized newly created project resource is available as the trace destination.
findings.required_fix: Resolve an existing project resource and its identifier, or create one through the configured supported Agent Observability SDK/API endpoint when authorized; never invent an identifier. A compatible local gateway delegates the normal resource request using its active Studio cloud connection, without an application cloud token.
acceptance_criteria: The selected project identifier resolves to a real Agent Observability project; if access is unavailable, record the exact authorization blocker.
constraints: Do not fabricate a project or identifier, and keep access tokens in operator-owned secret storage.
follow_up_actions: Confirm the resolved project exists through the selected API endpoint before configuring its runtime export.

findings.title: Resolve a dedicated Agent Stream
findings.gap: The interactive FastAPI deployment has no resolved dedicated Agent Stream binding or identifier; eval_runner.py resolves or creates an offline evaluation stream only.
findings.impact: The application has no verified stream destination and its traces can mix with unrelated agents.
findings.product_outcome: A dedicated Agent Stream exists in the resolved project and can be selected as the trace destination.
findings.required_fix: Resolve an existing dedicated Agent Stream resource in the selected project, or create one through the configured supported Agent Observability SDK/API endpoint when authorized; never invent an identifier or configure a global Studio stream destination.
acceptance_criteria: The selected Agent Stream identifier resolves to a real stream in the selected project; if access is unavailable, record the exact authorization blocker.
constraints: Do not fabricate a stream or identifier, and keep access tokens out of tracked files.
follow_up_actions: Confirm the resolved stream belongs to the selected project before configuring per-request runtime routing.

findings.title: Persist supported Agent Observability runtime routing
findings.gap: The interactive FastAPI deployment has no durable supported API/ingest endpoint configuration or per-request binding for a live project and Agent Stream. The optional eval_runner.py publishes a synthetic evaluation trace through its own logger and does not instrument app.py chat.
findings.impact: Traces can remain unassigned, mix with other applications, or be mistaken for cloud Agent Observability delivery after only local or APM receipt.
findings.product_outcome: The deployed application uses ordinary supported SDK/API calls and OTLP export to its selected project and dedicated Agent Stream through the selected gateway or explicit direct-cloud endpoint.
findings.required_fix: Persist supported SDK API/console/auth configuration and the matching ingest endpoint for the installed version. Default local work to an available cloud-compatible Studio gateway, preserving explicit operator destinations and direct-cloud mode. Keep cloud realm/token server-side in gateway mode and bind the project/Agent Stream on each request/export, without a Studio-specific application adapter, startup discovery, or global destination registration.
acceptance_criteria: Normal SDK/API resource calls and the exporter exercise the selected endpoint mode. Gateway mode derives upstream realm/auth from the active Studio connection with no application cloud token; explicit direct-cloud mode remains valid.

Two application streams preserve distinct project/stream bindings per request without cross-application leakage or changing a global AO destination. Unavailable or changed gateway connections are reported without silent destination switches or reuse of old-organization IDs.

A fresh application trace is visible in the selected cloud Agent Stream. Local receipt, resource API success, upstream ingest acknowledgement, or ordinary APM visibility alone leaves cloud AO delivery Not proven.
Configured endpoints and project/Agent Stream identifiers remain operator-overridable; cloud secrets are not committed and gateway local credentials are not represented as cloud credentials.
constraints: Use only supported normal SDK configuration and documented routing headers or attributes; preserve selected operator endpoints and managed dependencies/lockfiles.

Do not patch SDK vendors, mix incompatible endpoint and realm modes, discover Studio endpoints at app startup, or introduce an application-specific gateway API. A selected gateway is an honest runtime availability dependency.
follow_up_actions: Exercise ordinary resource calls and fresh trace export using the configured endpoint mode, then confirm the exact fresh interaction in its intended cloud project and Agent Stream. Keep configuration, gateway receipt/forwarding, and cloud visibility evidence separate.

scenarios.trigger: POST /v1/chat with bounded input and the registered search_docs and lookup_customer tools
scenarios.expected_signals: chat demo-gpt-4o-mini, execute_tool search_docs, and execute_tool lookup_customer spans plus gen_ai.client.token.usage and assistant.stream.active metrics
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The generated telemetry contains the exact bounded GenAI signal names and required semantic attributes without raw content or identifier dimensions.

scenarios.trigger: POST /v1/chat with bounded input and tools=[search_docs]
scenarios.expected_signals: Exactly one execute_tool search_docs span and exactly one nested retrieval demo-knowledge-base span with gen_ai.operation.name=retrieval and gen_ai.data_source.id=demo-knowledge-base
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The retrieval span parent span ID equals the execute_tool search_docs span ID, and neither span contains gen_ai.retrieval.query.text, gen_ai.retrieval.documents, raw query text, or document content.

scenarios.trigger: Use normal SDK calls to resolve the authorized project and two distinct dedicated Agent Streams, then export a fresh bounded application interaction to each through the selected gateway or explicit direct-cloud endpoint
scenarios.expected_signals: Supported project/stream API calls, completed bounded app-owned spans, per-request project/stream headers, and the exact fresh interactions in their intended cloud Agent Streams
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The ordinary installed SDK and exporter target the persisted non-default API/ingest endpoints without an app-specific adapter or startup discovery. Gateway mode uses active Studio realm/auth with no app cloud token and no global AO binding; two streams remain isolated. Report unavailable or changed connection behavior honestly and do not reuse old-organization IDs silently. Resource resolution, local receipt, and upstream forwarding are separate outcomes; local ACK is not cloud visibility. Without exact fresh interactions in the intended cloud streams, cloud delivery remains Not proven while credential-free configuration/lifecycle proof can still pass.

recommendation: Select OTEL-001 and OTEL-002 and run $otel-instrument, then verify the bounded GenAI lifecycle and nested retrieval operation.
